description: Rated wallet JSON export: top-level metadata, an overall block (aggregated attribute groups), and one block per variant (MOBILE, DESKTOP, BROWSER, EMBEDDED, HARDWARE) present in variants, each with the same attribute-group structure as overall.

types.description: Wallet types (SOFTWARE, HARDWARE, EMBEDDED) this wallet belongs to.

variants.description: List of variants (MOBILE, DESKTOP, BROWSER, EMBEDDED, HARDWARE) this wallet has. Each variant in this list has a corresponding key on the root object with the same attribute-group structure as overall.

lastUpdated.description: Date the wallet data was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

stage.description: Walletbeat stage label, or null if not applicable.

oneOf.description: Per-stage criteria passed/total and status for the primary ladder; null when stage is not applicable.

website.description: Primary website URL for the wallet, when known.

repository.description: Primary source code repository URL, when known.

overall.description: Aggregated evaluation across all variants. Keys are attribute group ids (e.g. security, privacy); values are objects keyed by attribute id, each with attribute metadata and rating block.

additionalProperties.description: Per-variant blocks: MOBILE, DESKTOP, BROWSER, EMBEDDED, HARDWARE. Only variants listed in the variants array appear. Each has the same structure as overall (attribute groups keyed by group id, then attribute id, then attribute + rating block).

stageBreakdownItem.description: One stage in the ladder: id, label, criteria counts, derived status, and per-group/criterion details.

criteriaGroups.description: Criteria groups with heading and per-criterion details (mirrors markdown).

stageCriteriaGroupBreakdownItem.description: One criteria group within a stage (mirrors markdown #### heading + bullets).

stageCriterionBreakdownItem.description: One criterion within a stage (mirrors markdown bullet with attribute link and rating).

attributeGroupsExport.description: Map of attribute group id (e.g. security, privacy) to group export (attribute id to attribute + rating block). Used for overall and for each variant block.

attributeGroupExport.description: One attribute group: map of attribute id to attribute export block (attribute metadata + rating).

attributeExportBlock.description: Single attribute export: attribute metadata (display name, question, methodology) plus wallet-specific rating (rating, shortExplanation, details, optional impact, howToImprove, references).

shortQuestion.description: Short question describing what the attribute evaluates (e.g. "Can you send and receive tokens without revealing your transaction history to others?")

whyItMatters.description: Body of the "Why does this matter?" / "Why should I care?" section

howIsEvaluated.description: Section heading and body for "How is this attribute evaluated?"

ratingBlock.description: Wallet-specific evaluation result for one attribute (rating, explanation, details, optional impact, howToImprove, references).

shortExplanation.description: Brief explanation of why this rating was assigned.

details.description: Longer explanation or summary of the evaluation; may be "See full details on the wallet page." when details are component-based.

reference.description: Optional reference with explanation and one or more URLs.
